clauses.quote: These Teachers shall receive, at a minimum, the salaries and benefits provided by this Agreement.
Assignment to a Partnership School shall be voluntary.
clauses.notes: Describes voluntary nature of assignment rather than active permission or duty.

clauses.quote: Teachers who are employed at Partnership Schools may be required to work a longer day and a longer year than is required under this Agreement.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who are employed at Partnership Schools
clauses.notes: Passive construction 'may be required' places duty on teachers, benefiting management.

clauses.quote: Teachers who are employed at Partnership Schools may be required to undertake job responsibilities and to participate in staff meetings and other activities beyond the requirements of this Agreement.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who are employed at Partnership Schools
clauses.notes: Same structure as above; duty on teachers for additional responsibilities.

clauses.quote: In advance of accepting assignment to a Partnership School, Teachers shall receive, for each School, information detailing any differences, if any, in the working conditions at the Partnership Schools and those in this Agreement including, but not limited to:
clauses.notes: Clause introduces a list of specific conditions; main operative clause extracts the entitlement to receive information.

clauses.quote: DCPS is prohibited from substantially changing the working conditions at any Partnership School during any school year.
If DCPS desires to implement working conditions or compensation at any Partnership School that are different than those found in this Agreement, DCPS must first negotiate such terms with the WTU.
clauses.notes: Mandatory negotiation duty imposed on management for substantive changes.

clauses.quote: If the Parties are unable to agree, the working condition or compensation at the Partnership Schools shall remain the same as defined in this Agreement.
clauses.subject_text: the working condition or compensation at the Partnership Schools
clauses.notes: Status quo maintenance clause triggered by negotiation impasse.

clauses.quote: The evaluation process in Partnership Schools shall be the same as other DCPS schools.
clauses.subject_text: The evaluation process in Partnership Schools
